title: 5.12 Un día en el mercado y el café
unit_outcome: Follow audio clues to identify market goods, food preferences, and complete café purchases.
sub_lesson_title: Un día en el mercado y el café
goal: Complete market purchases and a café order, with spoken agreement, negative wants/needs, named prices and polite requests.
grammar_function: Integrate food wants/needs, purchasing actions, and polite requests.
speaking_outcome: Speak polite café orders and price answers aloud across final voice gates.
